stories.headline: FBI and US Secret Service working with Binance after $6.3 billion hack, source says
stories.summary: Binance suffered a $6.3 billion hack and federal law enforcement agencies are now engaged in the investigation. This represents one of the largest cryptocurrency theft incidents on record.
stories.why_matters: Crypto market stability and regulatory scrutiny could impact risk sentiment and digital asset valuations in US equity and fixed income markets.

stories.headline: Swiss central bank posts bumper $23bn profit as gold, foreign assets soar
stories.summary: The Swiss National Bank reported exceptional profitability driven by gains in gold and foreign exchange holdings. This reflects strong central bank balance sheet expansion amid volatile markets.
stories.why_matters: Central bank strength and foreign reserve appreciation signal currency stability and global monetary confidence, relevant to FX and cross-border capital flows.

stories.headline: Trump on Iran war: It's going to get wrapped up soon
stories.summary: Former President Trump suggested that tensions with Iran are approaching resolution. Concurrent reports indicate ongoing naval incidents in the Strait of Hormuz with limpet mine attacks on tankers.
stories.why_matters: Geopolitical de-escalation or continued conflict directly impacts crude oil pricing, energy sector valuations, and broader macroeconomic risk premia.

calendar.note: Federal Reserve policy guidance directly affects Treasury yields, equity valuations, and forward rate expectations.
Wage and benefit growth data is critical for inflation forecasts and Fed rate path determination.
Elevated uncertainty readings can amplify VIX and influence equity market positioning.

concept.title: Yield Curve Steepening amid Geopolitical Uncertainty
concept.one_liner: 10Y Treasury yields rise while 2Y falls, reflecting long-end repricing on inflation persistence and geopolitical risk premiums.
concept.explanation: The 10Y/2Y spread is widening as the 10Y rose 6 bps to 5.05% while the 2Y fell 3 bps to 4.67%. This steepening typically occurs when markets price in sustained inflation or tail risks—here, tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran tensions create energy cost uncertainty. Simultaneously, S&P 500 weakness (-1.22%) and VIX uptick (+0.29 to 17.20) reflect equity de-rating as investors demand higher long-dated risk premiums.
concept.market_link: Rising long yields compress equity multiples and widen credit spreads, while geopolitical oil risk keeps inflation expectations anchored above 5% on the 10Y.

narrative: US equities fell 1.22% ahead of Friday's FOMC announcement as the yield curve steepened—10Y Treasury yields rose 6 bps to 5.05% amid persistent inflation concerns and escalating Middle East tensions (tanker attacks, Iran negotiations), while the 2Y fell 3 bps, reflecting near-term rate hold expectations. The $6.3 billion Binance hack and broader crypto sector volatility add tail-risk sentiment, pushing VIX 0.29 points higher, though EUR/USD strength signals modest US dollar weakness as markets await FOMC guidance and employment data.
